t: You're outside the Admiral Duncan, a pub on Old Compton Street in Soho, well known as one of Soho's oldest gay pubs. It takes its name from Adam Duncan, the first Viscount Duncan, a Royal Navy admiral. He served in the Seven Years' War, the American War of Independence and the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He is best known for defeating the Batavian Navy at the Battle of Camperdown in 1797, one of the most significant naval battles of the French Revolutionary Wars.
